These costs concern distinct tasks: reusable memory, complete arbitrary-input channels retaining final memory, fixed-input marginal states, and archive-only channels. They are not interchangeable and are not hardware, energy or thermodynamic minima. The complete-channel statements retain arbitrary inert input references. Initial mixed preparation and any purifier, clocks, controls and independent fresh ports remain declared resources. Equality of passive output laws is not equality under arbitrary interventions.
